Class PortfolioValuationService

java.lang.Object
app.account.PortfolioValuationService
@Service public class PortfolioValuationService extends Object
Captures current holdings on real dates, independently of the replay calendar.

    • PortfolioValuationService

      @Autowired public PortfolioValuationService(AccountService accounts, AccountRepository accountRepository, HoldingMovementRepository movements, PortfolioValuationRepository valuations, MarketReplayService market)
      Creates the valuation service using the actual UTC clock.
      Parameters:
      accounts - owned-account holdings and cost basis
      accountRepository - account locking
      movements - existing acquisition ledger
      valuations - persisted observations
      market - current replay prices

  • Method Details

    • capture

      @Transactional public PortfolioValuationService.Point capture(Integer accountId, UUID userId, boolean scheduled)
      Captures a current observation after checking ownership. New accounts stay empty.
      Parameters:
      accountId - owned account
      userId - verified caller
      scheduled - whether unchanged captures in the same minute should be coalesced
      Returns:
      observation, or null when the account has never bought shares
      Throws:
      AccountNotFoundException - for a missing account
      ForbiddenException - for another user's account

    • history

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public List<PortfolioValuationService.Point> history(Integer accountId, UUID userId, String timeframe)
      Returns observations with a zero baseline before the first investment and the latest value carried to now.
      Parameters:
      accountId - owned account
      userId - verified caller
      timeframe - supported chart range
      Returns:
      chronological chart points, including presentation endpoints that are not persisted
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for an unsupported timeframe
      AccountNotFoundException - for a missing account
      ForbiddenException - for another user's account
